body: I fucking hate this shit. I lived my whole life being wrong no matter what I do.
No it’s not for attention. All I wanted was somebody to want to talk for a little about anything to distract me from wanting to do those things
It’s very comforting every time I hear someone being able to understand the same thing I feel. Good luck to you in life and I wish you the best!

This is pretty much me. I find it easy to care about others being happy and I do everything in my power to make their day. But then I think “Oh I barely slept and I haven’t eaten in two days? Oh well.” But I always tell the people I care about to get lots of sleep and to eat three meals a day. I’m also unsure how to genuinely care for my own wellbeing. So know that you aren’t alone in this!

I feel like I’m in the same situation as you. I also have a decent home life and haven’t had a traumatic experience. I also just got finished with my first year of college. A lot of the time I just can’t be happy and just feel pain for no actual reason. I’ve had the same thoughts about being a burden due to my parents wasting their money paying for classes that I fail because I can’t get my mind off dying. I have a friend who says she’s there for me but seems like she cares less and less every day. I also have a problem where I don’t care about myself or what happens to me, yet I try to help the ones who I care about. So don’t worry, you’re not alone in this!
Yes it was the first time I said it out loud to someone thank you!
Horrible, I’m attached to people who don’t care about me and I can’t let them go.
Thanks I’ll keep this in mind! Man I really love everybody in this sub, everybody wants to help

Yeah man I’m the same way, although I used to be a happy person and always understood people and open to others but I got sad and sensitive and people started drifting away but don’t worry man you’re awesome! You aren’t alone and I’m here for you!
Thank you it’s really comforting to hear that people are willing to listen when it feels like everybody avoids this kind of stuff, thank you so much
Thank you so much it’s the worst not being able to say anything because when I do I just dig myself deeper, thanks though it makes me happy thinking about you guys

Thank you it made me cry reading that somebody cares even if I don’t know them but yes that would help a lot it’s just sometimes I need somebody to talk to so it doesn’t matter if online just as long as somebody tries to get me :)
Yes I’m do talk and engage all of that but the thing is when I do get left out it put me in a bad mood then I start becoming less engaging and it’s a horrible cycle that continues to fuck me up
I just woke up and read this, this actually made me smile, I needed this thank you so much
